essence: This form of the goddess is depicted as elegantly dressed and adorned with pleasing anklets.
The goddess is invoked as Vanadurgā and as Mataṅgī, who is honored by the sage Mataṅga.
The goddess manifests as Cāmuṇḍā, Vārāhī, Lakṣmī, and also in a male form.
This form of the goddess is abundant, full of love, and rides upon all vehicles.
The goddess is identified as the slayer of Madhu and Kaiṭabha and the destroyer of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa.
